Name: Casino Soundscape
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[left][b]Casino Soundscape[/b] gives the Calico Desert Casino a proper soundtrack by adding upbeat swing music alongside a lively layer of cards, poker chips, and dice.[/left]

Music and ambience are handled separately, so you can adjust the casino music with Stardew Valley’s [b]Music[/b] slider while the table sounds remain controlled by the [b]Ambience[/b] slider.

Now the casino actually sounds like people are gambling in it. Revolutionary. 🎰

[center]🎲━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎲[/center]

[size=4][b]🎷 MOD FEATURES[/b][/size]

🎶 [b]Casino Music[/b]
Adds the loopable jazz track [b]Catchy Swing[/b] to the Calico Desert Casino.

🃏 [b]Casino Ambience[/b]
Adds a custom ambience mix made from card handling, poker chip, and dice sounds.

🔊 [b]Independent Volume Controls[/b]
Music and ambience use separate audio channels:
[b]Music slider[/b] → Catchy Swing
[b]Ambience slider[/b] → Cards, chips, and dice

🎰 [b]A Busier Casino[/b]
The ambience was mixed to sound like several active tables around the room, with frequent cards and chips, occasional dice rolls, and overlapping activity.

🎧 [b]No Music Ducking[/b]
Casino ambience does not lower the volume of the background music.

📍 [b]Casino Only[/b]
Casino Soundscape only affects the Calico Desert Casino and does not modify the rest of Stardew Valley’s soundtrack.


[center]🎲━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎲[/center]

[size=4][b]🎥 STREAMER FRIENDLY[/b][/size]

Both audio sources used by Casino Soundscape are released under [b]CC0 1.0 Universal[/b]. This permits commercial use, modification, redistribution, and use in monetized streams and videos.

As always, automated copyright systems can theoretically make incorrect claims about virtually any audio, but both source assets have clear CC0 licensing.

[center]🎰━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎰[/center]

[size=4][b]📦 REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]

Casino Soundscape requires:

🔧 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
🧩 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
🔊 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37134]Positional Audio[/url]

Positional Audio allows the casino’s music and ambience layers to play simultaneously while remaining connected to their respective Stardew Valley volume sliders.

[center]🃏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🃏[/center]

[size=4][b]📥 INSTALLATION[/b][/size]

1. Install [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b], and [b]Positional Audio[/b].
2. Download Casino Soundscape.
3. Extract the mod folder into: [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
5. Head to the Calico Desert Casino and enjoy your newly functional atmosphere. 🎷

[center]🎲━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎲[/center]

[size=4][b]🤝 COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]

Casino Soundscape edits the music assigned to the Casino’s internal [b]Club[/b] location and adds a Positional Audio ambience layer there.

It does [b]not[/b] modify:

🌵 The rest of the Calico Desert
🎰 Casino gameplay
🃏 CalicoJack
🪙 Qi Coins
👁️ Mr. Qi’s questionable business practices
🗺️ Maps
💬 Dialogue
🧍 NPCs

Mods which also replace the Casino’s music may conflict depending on how they apply their changes.

Other Positional Audio ambience mods can coexist with Casino Soundscape, though multiple mods targeting the Casino may result in their ambience layers playing simultaneously.

[center]🎰━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎰[/center]
